# Arrival save fixture

`arrival-v2.sav` is a 131,088-byte Flash1M save written through the Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by libmGBA. Its selected save slot resumes in Carabrue Town Home 1F (map 79:1, warp 255); SHA-256 is `b6493f464b5d114090ad9c6672be94ff852582f49ee3adaef1c4a09760ebc2ed`.

The fixture carries identity registry version 2 and remains a historical save sample.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-carabrue.sav` is a 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M save written through the current Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by pinned mGBA 0.11. It was seeded from a synthetic registry-v3 adaptation of the older fixture, then overwritten by the ROM; it is not a fresh-new-game save. The source ROM is the clean two-world build at `f59cc59416`, Cormoria ROM SHA-256 `11c510cec9e03ce84a713aa982eea70da08619d30dd7da5c199cff4836a9326c`. The save SHA-256 is `c17f39cd98342281ab0de668a6b9daa83f264f058ac642a55d5b5543f90e6765`. `verify_arrival_save` accepts registry v3, map 79:1, warp 255 and layout 1194. Catalog contract tests use this immutable image instead of modifying a save's registry bytes in Python.

The previous checked-in Lilycove and Rivetshore saves had the correct map IDs, layouts and selected-slot `mapView` bytes, but their saved object events and templates differed from the ROM-written harbor state. Cold continuation and NPC interaction exposed the wrong dialogue. An earlier signed-desktop snapshot also showed black map gaps; that was a different save image. Checking only map ID and layout did not catch either failure.

`arrival-v3-main-lilycove.sav` is the 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M save from the Main character. Its selected slot reached generation 5 through the local server lineage. A scratch copy staged a one-time `CONTINUE_GAME_WARP` to Lilycove Harbor (map 13:10, warp 255, x=8, y=11), with affected sector checksums recalculated. The exact Main ROM (SHA-256 `c431be348a6de9d363ba9f4a358b6b7bd4599ced2bf18562140adc0cda56a3f6`) executed the warp, populated the full dock and correct attendant, and wrote generation 6 through its in-game Save menu. Pinned mGBA 0.11 cold-Continued that generation-6 image unchanged to the outdoor dock. Fixture SHA-256: `ab0a27b06ee2e0df69deb04939b2ff70876d1516f999c25bb252639cb30c5988`. The strict verifier accepts map 13:10, warp 255 and layout 88.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-rivetshore.sav` is the 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M save from the Cormoria character. A scratch copy staged a one-time `CONTINUE_GAME_WARP` to Rivetshore Harbor (map 82:21, warp 255, x=8, y=14), with affected sector checksums recalculated. The exact Cormoria ROM (SHA-256 `b7b4d0477920b3b053a603e356b1ce243d629576d9db6d8c94aecf2770019505`) executed the warp, populated the full dock and correct attendant, and wrote generation 6 through its in-game Save menu. Pinned mGBA 0.11 cold-Continued that generation-6 image unchanged to the outdoor dock. Fixture SHA-256: `1f4bb7b6d85ff0a63ff6650aa722692edc757a03149b0765d55fa5fa7b93b011`. The strict verifier accepts map 82:21, warp 255 and layout 1314.

The Carabrue image remains a contract fixture. These two harbor images demonstrate coherent cold arrivals under the stated ROM hashes. A live cross-ROM player-data roundtrip is still required for release validation.
